title: Match analysis
subtitle: Upload a match clip and get team numbers: distance covered, speed, pitch control, possession and heatmaps.

requirements.title: Which clips work
requirements.camera: A broadcast-style view from a fixed, elevated camera
requirements.pitch: Most of the pitch and its lines in frame. Close-ups and touchline phone clips won't map
requirements.length: Only the first 5 minutes are analysed
requirements.format: MP4 or MOV, up to {{limit}} MB: 5 minutes at 720p fits

upload.keepOpen: Keep this tab open until the upload finishes.
upload.doneText: It is in the queue. This page updates by itself.
upload.failedText: Check your connection and try again.
upload.wrongType: Only MP4 and MOV videos are supported.
upload.tooLarge: This file is {{size}} MB, the limit is {{limit}} MB. Trim it to the first 5 minutes and export at 720p.
upload.signInAgain: Your session has expired. Sign in again and retry.

list.title: Your analyses
list.empty: No analyses yet. Upload your first match clip above.

pending.queuedText: The clip is uploaded and will be picked up by the analysis server. Uploaded {{time}}.
pending.processingText: Started {{time}}. A 5-minute clip usually takes several minutes.
pending.autoRefresh: You can leave this page. It refreshes by itself, and the report will be in your list.

errors.title: Analysis failed
errors.pitch_calibration_insufficient: The pitch could not be recognised in enough frames. Use a wide, elevated view where the pitch lines are visible.
errors.no_players: No players were found in the clip. Make sure it shows a match.
errors.generic: Something went wrong while analysing this clip. Try again, or upload a different clip.

detail.honesty: Every number comes only from frames where the pitch could be mapped ({{percent}}% of {{seconds}} analysed seconds). Tracker IDs break when players are hidden, so per-player rows are shown as tracks.
detail.notMapped: pitch not mapped at this moment
detail.dominanceHint: Team A's share of the pitch area. Counted in {{count}} frames that had enough players of both teams on the map.
detail.dominanceUnavailable: Not available: no frame had at least 5 mapped players on each team.
detail.tracksHint: One row per tracked identity, not per player: when a player is hidden, the tracker may split them into several tracks.

reasons.ball: the ball was seen in only {{percent}}% of frames
reasons.radius: no player was ever close enough to the ball
